summary: The article reports the principal data sources, search tools, architecture blocks, training stages, losses and evaluation filters, while directing extensive pseudocode and hyperparameter details to Methods and Supplementary material.

findings.statement: The source names MSA/template databases, search tools, PDB release dates, model stages, TPU training and key losses, making the high-level procedure reproducible in principle.
findings.reason: These details anchor the implementation context and prevent a vague neural-network description.

findings.statement: Exact algorithm details, pseudocode, network diagrams, input features and training details are deferred to Supplementary Methods and Tables.
findings.reason: A Reader should distinguish article-level comprehension from an implementation recipe.

cross_cutting_checks.counterfactual: Reimplementation from the six main-text pages alone would require consulting the referenced Supplementary materials.

findings.statement: The evaluation's filtering rules and metric definitions are material implementation details: recent-PDB analysis excludes close templates and uses coverage/resolution filters, while confidence is assessed with bootstrap intervals.
findings.reason: Reproducing headline numbers requires reproducing selection and uncertainty procedures, not only network code.
